name: Security Service Federal Credit Union
notes: Researched from public ssfcu.org pages (no sign-in). Catalog routed this credit union to kubra; moved to bank-billpay (loans are paid inside Security Service Online Banking). Online: Transfers & Payments tab > Make a Payment (Security Service account) or Manage Transfers & Payments > Add Account (non-Security Service account); recurring via "Recurring" under Set the Payment Frequency & Date; enrolment may need the 10-digit savings/checking number. Without online banking: ACI Payments, Inc. (Speedpay guest page) with the 10-digit loan account number or 16-digit card number plus ZIP (guestLookupExact); after 8 p.m. CT processes next business day; card payments may post as a cash advance at the card issuer. Fees: ACI payments by debit card, through a phone rep or in a branch are $7.50 (guestCardCents 750); automated phone line (1.866.397.4512) is free; recurring payments can also be set up on that line, or with the ACH Payment Authorization form. Member Contact Center 1.800.527.7328. Mail: P.O. Box 691530, San Antonio, TX 78269-1530. Hardship/payment plans not found publicly (family default).

pay_online.note: Online and mobile payments are free. Pay from a Security Service account, or add a non-Security Service account under Manage Transfers & Payments.

guest_pay.note: Pay with ACI Payments, Inc. using your 10-digit loan account number (or 16-digit card number) and ZIP code. Payments after 8 p.m. CT process the next business day; debit card payments cost $7.50.

autopay.note: Under Transfers & Payments choose Make a Payment, then Recurring in Set the Payment Frequency & Date. You can also set up recurring payments by phone at 1.866.397.4512.

pay_by_phone.note: Payments through the automated phone system are free; payments through a representative or by card cost $7.50.

notes: Phone payments through a representative, and card payments by phone or in a branch, cost $7.50; the automated phone system is free.

help.title: Ways to make a loan payment
paragraphs: Make your monthly payment in Security Service Online Banking or the mobile app, any time and free of charge. Select Transfers & Payments, then Make a Payment to pay from a Security Service account; to pay from another institution choose Manage Transfers & Payments and Add Account first.

Without online banking, pay through ACI Payments, Inc. with your full 10-digit loan account number (or 16-digit card number) and ZIP code. Payments after 8 p.m. CT process the next business day, and a card payment may be treated as a cash advance by your card issuer.

You can also call 1.866.397.4512, mail your payment with the coupon or loan number to Security Service Federal Credit Union, P.O. Box 691530, San Antonio, TX 78269-1530, or pay at a branch or Shared Branching location.

help.title: Recurring payments
paragraphs: Log in to Online Banking, open the Transfers & Payments tab, choose the account type you are paying and select Make a Payment. Set the payment accounts and amount, then pick Recurring under Set the Payment Frequency & Date.
You can also call 1.866.397.4512, make your payment, and stay on the line to schedule a recurring monthly payment, or bring an ACH Payment Authorization form to a branch.

help.title: Payment fees
paragraphs: Online and mobile payments are free, and so are payments through the automated phone system. Payments through a phone representative, and debit or credit card payments by phone or in a branch, carry a $7.50 money transfer fee charged through ACI Payments, Inc.

extra.intent: Using Security Service's help pages, find the fee for paying a loan with a debit card through ACI Payments. Do not make a payment or change any settings.
Using Security Service's help pages, find the time after which ACI Payments processes a payment on the next business day. Do not make a payment or change any settings.

solution.text: Payments made after 8 p.m. CT process the next business day.
